datasets.title: Somalia - Drought situation in Somalia
datasets.description: This dataset shows the drought situation in Somalia. The year 2015 rainy season experienced El Nino conditions that resulted into good rains in many parts of the country. Despite this, the northern parts of the country are facing drought conditions.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/somalia-drought-situation-in-somalia]

lineage.description: FAO SWALIM conducted empirical assessment of drought conditions across Somalia during the 2015 rainy season, mapping spatial extent of drought in northern regions despite El Niño-induced rainfall in other areas. Data was compiled into shapefile format for geographic information system analysis.

sources.name: FAO SWALIM
sources.description: FAO Somali Water and Land Information Management system providing observed drought situation mapping and spatial assessment of drought conditions across Somalia
